{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nyemari Imperial Military Installation''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] operatives known as the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] [[Mission to Nyemari|infiltrated]] the [[Nyemari Royal Palace]] to steal the Duchess' access codes to the Nyemari Imperial facility. Their attempt succeeded, but the Rebels were forced to flee the palace after tripping the silent alarm.<ref name="RF: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nyemari Imperial Military Installation was referenced as the target of the Rebel's raid in the beginning of [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
